sentence: Your frenemy cannot find you in a weafloaf room.

wombos.definition: The lowkey, collective version of being fully yourselves together — a group operating at peak authenticity in a chill, understated way.
wombos.example: No pressure, no performance — just the whole squad being weafloaf.

wombos.definition: A person who acts as a friend but is simultaneously a rival or adversary — someone whose friendship is tinged with competition or hostility.
wombos.example: She congratulates me every time I win, but I know she's my frenemy.
